overlaps.rationale: A weekday is a Monday–Friday day, whereas a weekend is the Saturday–Sunday period; the senses are complementary and distinct.
Monday is one specific weekday; weekday refers to the general Monday–Friday category.
Sunday is not included in the candidate sense, which explicitly covers Monday through Friday.
